interestingFact: India is the world’s largest democracy and the birthplace of chess.
The U.S. has the world’s largest economy by nominal GDP.
Japan has more than 6,800 islands and is home to the world’s oldest company.
Brazil is home to the Amazon Rainforest, which produces 20% of the world’s oxygen.
Germany is known for its engineering excellence and the world’s first printed book was made here.
Australia is the only continent covered by a single country and home to kangaroos.
Canada has the longest coastline in the world, spanning more than 202,000 km.
The Eiffel Tower was originally meant to be a temporary structure for the 1889 World Fair.
South Africa has three capital cities and 11 official languages.
The UK has no written constitution — it is based on laws, traditions, and conventions.
